# GRUB modules built into Canonical's signed monolithic GRUB, the disk image the stick ships as
# EFI/BOOT/grubx64.efi: /usr/lib/grub/x86_64-efi-signed/grubx64.efi.signed from
# grub-efi-amd64-signed 1.215+2.14-2ubuntu1 (GRUB 2.14, Ubuntu 26.04.1 resolute; the version
# on the 26.04.1 desktop ISO and in the archive on 2026-10-17).
# image: 2828168 bytes, sha256 33e1d46cb68e41a293c767750078bbdb857ad7c1197a2206dea737bc9ccb8dbf
# 26.04.1's ISO boots the CD image of the same package (gcdx64.efi.signed, 2,398,088 bytes,
# also EFI/boot/grubx64.efi on the ISO): its 95 modules are a subset of these 122.
# Compared with the same file of the previous LTS (grub-efi-amd64-signed 1.202.5+2.12-1ubuntu7.3,
# GRUB 2.12): dropped all_video efi_uga ntfs pgp video_bochs video_cirrus; added gcry_hwfeatures
# gcry_keccak key_protector pubkey. Under Secure Boot shim refuses modules loaded from disk,
# so a grub.cfg that insmods a dropped one fails.
# Regenerate: python3 -I stick/scripts/grub-builtin-modules.py <image>   (one name per line)
